payloads.name: Prospero Manager
payloads.description: All-in-one web-based PS5 homebrew manager
payloads.author: notmaj0r

payloads.name: Orbit Store
payloads.description: PS5 game download manager with a browser-based interface
payloads.author: saawant12

payloads.name: BlackBox
payloads.description: WARNING: Developer says do not launch this ELF with Payload Manager. Install PPSA01453.ffpkg via ShadowMount instead.
payloads.author: D3ATHLY
payloads.release_notes: Developer warning: Do not launch blackbox.elf using Payload Manager. Install PPSA01453.ffpkg with ShadowMount; the ELF is bundled inside the FFPKG.

payloads.name: HyperHEN
payloads.description: All-in-one PS5 HEN, HyperCore and Toolbox. Requires a jailbroken PS5 and external elfldr; check exact firmware support before launching.
payloads.author: Michele-M-Media
payloads.release_notes: Requires a jailbroken PS5 with an external elfldr on TCP 9021. Firmware support uses exact profiles; some profiles have not been hardware-validated. Read the upstream release notes before launching.

payloads.name: RESTORE_PM
payloads.description: Restore the Payload Manager home screen icon on a jailbroken PS5 when it is missing or will not open. Does not remove other apps.
payloads.author: KINGDKAK

payloads.name: LiveShell Engine
payloads.description: Animated wallpaper engine for the PS5 home screen. Requires a jailbroken PS5 and an ELF loader.
payloads.author: ZiZc3

payloads.name: Kura Loader (PS5)
payloads.description: PS5 companion payload for Kura; web dashboard, mounts and homebrew management. Use only the PS5 ELF.
payloads.author: NookieAI

payloads.name: YetAnotherControllerEnabler
payloads.description: Bridge supported USB or adapter-connected controllers to a virtual DualSense on PS5.
payloads.author: MegaCadeDev

payloads.name: Snes9x PS5 (Installer + Helper)
payloads.description: Installs and supports a separate Snes9x PS5 home-screen emulator app; this ELF is not the standalone emulator.
payloads.author: MisterTemaki

payloads.name: PS5 LAN Transfer
payloads.description: Local network file transfer service limited to /data/ps5-transfer; runs on TCP 9022. Use on a trusted LAN.
payloads.author: Uss15

payloads.name: PS5 Unified Autoloader
payloads.description: Automates launch of configured payloads during jailbreak chains; intended for startup-chain integration, not routine manual launch.
payloads.author: itsPLK

payloads.name: PKG Sender Receiver (PS5)
payloads.description: PS5-side receiver for companion PKG Sender desktop software. Listens on port 12800; use on a trusted LAN.
payloads.author: Loopayeh

payloads.name: PS5SX2 Installer
payloads.description: Installer and updater for the separate PS5SX2 PlayStation 2 emulator home-screen app. Also load the matching PS5SXHelper ELF.
payloads.author: Swordpdf

payloads.name: PS5SX2 Helper
payloads.description: Helper payload used with kstuff and PS5SX2; install the PS5SX2 app separately. Use alongside PS5SX2Installer.
payloads.author: Swordpdf

payloads.name: SwanStationPS5 Disc Daemon
payloads.description: Optional daemon for PS1 disc detection and copying from a USB CD drive; requires SwanStationPS5 app.
payloads.author: darkxex

payloads.name: Ruffle Flash PS5 Helper
payloads.description: Helper for separate Ruffle Flash PS5 home-screen emulator. Install PPSA68091 app and load helper with kstuff.
payloads.author: ZiZc3

payloads.name: PS5X360 AutoLog (Preview)
payloads.description: Optional preview logging payload for the separate PS5X360 home-screen Xbox 360 emulator app; experimental and requires companion app. Check firmware compatibility.
payloads.author: BrinooTk

payloads.name: PS5 Unified Autoloader X
payloads.description: Alternative PS5 payload autoloader for jailbreak startup chains. Intended for use by compatible exploit hosts rather than routine manual launching.
payloads.author: bsk193

payloads.name: Prospero Menu
payloads.description: Community-expandable native PS5 overlay menu; L3+R3 in games and ShellUI. Load after kstuff and ShadowMount where used; upstream tested on PS5 firmware 13.60.
payloads.author: StonedModder

payloads.name: Puckbridge PS5 (Ghostcontrol-derived)
payloads.description: Steam Controller 2026 and Ghostcontrol-derived PS5 virtual-controller support with gyro aiming, flick stick, rumble, remapping, and a local web UI; experimental, tested on firmware 13.60.
payloads.author: ThisIsAkill

payloads.name: PSCloud Dashboard
payloads.description: Official PSCloud dashboard ELF; consult upstream documentation for usage.
payloads.author: bc160201983

payloads.name: RommPS RomM Sync
payloads.description: Official PS5 background RomM library download and bidirectional emulator save/savestate syncing payload. Requires jailbroken PS5 with etaHEN or onionHEN/kstuff and a RomM 5.2.0+ server; configure via web UI on port 8780. Back up saves before initial sync. PS5 ELF only, not the PS4 build.
payloads.author: s0liton

payloads.name: PS5 Linux Loader
payloads.description: PS5 Linux boot loader. Requires supported firmware and Linux installation/media; follow upstream hardware and rest-mode setup instructions. Supports listed 3.00–7.61 firmware profiles and experimental 13.60 on PS5 Phat, Slim and Pro. 13.60 stability is not guaranteed; do not update console firmware solely for this payload.
payloads.author: soniciso1

payloads.name: PS5 NZB Downloader
payloads.description: Experimental PS5 Usenet/NZB downloader with local web UI on port 4202, queue, PAR2 repair, and archive extraction. Requires jailbroken PS5 and a Usenet provider. Upstream labels releases prerelease; use at your own risk and only download content you are authorized to access.
payloads.author: lchmagKekse

payloads.name: PS4Mount
payloads.description: Mount PS4 fake PKG games from an exFAT USB drive on a jailbroken PS5 without installing the game packages to internal storage. Requires fPKG-capable jailbreak (for example etaHEN with kstuff), suitable ELF loader and access to kernel logs. Experimental; can trigger database-corruption/rebuild warnings on some firmware. Back up saves; read official instructions before use. Web panel on port 8770 has no password; use only on a trusted LAN.
payloads.author: gasb07

payloads.name: ezRemote Server
payloads.description: Official PS5 ezRemote Server background ELF, used with the separate ezRemote Client app to remotely install supported PS4/PS5 packages from FTP/SFTP, SMB, NFS, WebDAV and HTTP sources. Client can start this payload automatically; avoid loading duplicate instances. Use only with trusted servers and networks.
payloads.author: cy33hc
